prompt: A photorealistic 16:9 shot of a cheap black-box TV set, past the blurred shoulder and headphones of a camera operator in the left foreground. A masked comic presenter leans on a battered wooden lectern, lifting a glass of red wine toward the face he doesn't have in a guilty toast, his other gloved hand pressed to his chest. His head is a navy rib-knit wool balaclava, pilled, one continuous knitted surface over the whole face, tucked into a white shirt collar under a crumpled black suit jacket. A cream felt ring is stitched around the face; a small solid red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high inside it at two o'clock, on the right side of the image. Black leather gloves carry a small ring-and-triangle patch on each back. A creased orange curtain behind. The only light is a tungsten lamp on a stand at frame right, hard and warm, haloing the wool fuzz. Soft 1990s Betacam image. Thanks.
